newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan tenders for 2,000-4,000 T palm olein.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan tenders for 2,000-4,000 T palm olein.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) tendered on Tuesday for 2,000 to 4,000 tonnes of RBD palm olein for shipment by December 20, a TCP official said.
"We have asked suppliers to bid for any quantity between 2,000 to 4,000 tonnes but it would be our option to accept whatever price and quantity," a TCP official said.
The official said the TCP would only be interested in rates quoted below $557 per tonne FOB.
The TCP scrapped tenders for 2,000 tonnes of RBD palm olein on Thursday after receiving bids at $571 per tonne and $568.70 per tonne -- prices it considered too high, traders said.
The TCP bought 4,500 tonnes of RBD palm oil the same day at a C & F rate of $529.40 per tonne from Pan Century for shipment by December 10.
The TCP called the new palm olein tender on behalf of the state-run Ghee Corporation of Pakistan.
